target: Tier-1 morphology for Canary, Galapagos, and Seychelles functional/reproductive backbone systems

systems.source: Hervias-Parejo et al. 2019, American Journal of Botany 106:540-546, DOI 10.1002/ajb2.1270
systems.recovered_support: The primary article reports 16 floral morphology and nectar traits measured for 26 native Santa Cruz plant species; Appendix S2 contains mean, SD, min and max, n=5 flowers/species. This is directly relevant to the same Santa Cruz pollination programme used by the 2018 effectiveness evidence.
systems.remaining_gate: Recover and checksum Appendix S2, verify which of Cordia lutea, Cryptocarpus pyriformis, Opuntia echios and Waltheria ovata are present, then lock numeric traits before changing the matrix cell to source_locked_present.

systems.source: Published Lotus maculatus botanical and bird-flower trait literature, including Hind 2008 and Macaronesian bird-flower comparisons
systems.recovered_support: Lotus maculatus has source-level floral descriptions and comparative bird-flower trait context, but the inspected 2024 effectiveness study does not provide a matched quantitative floral-response transition for the experimental population.
systems.remaining_gate: Require population/transition-level quantitative morphology tied to the relevant Tenerife comparison before promoting the matrix cell.

systems.source: Fuster et al. 2020 pollination-effectiveness source and registered Figshare data
systems.recovered_support: The registered source-native files provide visitation, contact, single-visit reproductive outcome and breeding data for Polyscias crassa, Syzygium wrightii and Thespesia populnea, but no matched quantitative floral-response transition was recovered in the targeted route.
systems.remaining_gate: Reopen only for source-native morphology from the same taxa/populations or a defensible matched island transition.

next_executable_target: Galapagos Hervias-Parejo 2019 Appendix S2 numeric supplement
claim_boundary: Finding a morphology source is not equivalent to demonstrating evolutionary floral change. Numeric traits must be source-locked and linked to an explicit comparator before direction is inferred.
